entries.capability: Exercise Python and TypeScript exporters through a real OpenTelemetry Collector
entries.result: Twelve collector cases passed across healthy delivery, 503, lost acknowledgement, partial success, duplicate replay and restart.
entries.limits: Draft, unmerged implementation. Inputs and backend are synthetic. Row-count checks and backend deduplication do not prove exactly-once delivery, full projection fidelity, queue saturation or in-flight restart behavior.
